best_return_candidate.name: score_band_30_50_70
best_return_candidate.reason_rejected: Only three of six development years were positive.

findings: Directly clearing weak-market exposure improved the worst year and turnover but reduced cumulative return.
Faster regime recovery did not restore return because confirmation interacts with costs, drawdown caps and position state.
The 30/50/70 risk-score bands are informative and remain a future research lead, but they failed the majority-positive-year gate.
Risk-score extreme overrides did not beat the formal regime.
A pure 10-session target and a 5d/10d blend both failed; the 5d label is not the direct cause of product turnover.
Adding 25% transparent medium-term momentum duplicated existing information and reduced return.
Three-year recency weighting raised development return to 28.22% but produced only three positive years; five-year weighting retained four positive years but returned only 10.26%.
research_execution_note: Every retained result ends on 20231231. An early diagnostic runner that unnecessarily emitted later-period fields was discarded without using them for candidate selection.
runtime_note: Long Pandas replays were isolated by process with one numerical thread and bounded retries; only completed JSON results were retained.
next_step: Seek a genuinely new point-in-time sector feature with information not already encoded by price momentum, volatility or market breadth. Do not add another exposure rule, label-horizon variant or nearby recency parameter without new evidence.
